en.title: What is Archeris
en.excerpt: Archeris is a ticketing and scoring platform built specifically for archery tournaments — online registration, automated payments, live scoring at the target line, and instant elimination brackets, all in one place.

toc.text: 1. The Real Problem with Running Archery Tournaments
5. Manual vs Archeris: Side by Side

en.content:
Ask any archery tournament organizer what the hardest part of their job is, and most won't say "finding a venue" or "getting sponsors." They'll say: the paperwork, the scorecards, and chasing bank transfer confirmations on WhatsApp.

That's exactly where Archeris comes in. It's a web and mobile platform built specifically for archery tournaments, covering everything from the moment you open registration all the way through publishing final results and distributing certificates.

1. The Real Problem with Running Archery Tournaments

If you've ever helped organize an archery event the traditional way, the chaos is familiar. Registration comes in through a Google Form. Payment proofs flood your WhatsApp. Someone manually cross-checks bank mutations line by line. The target allocation spreadsheet has a formula error nobody caught until competition day. And on the field, scorecards get rained on, a volunteer misreads a handwritten number, and suddenly two archers are tied at a score that doesn't match what they actually shot.

Then comes the elimination bracket. Calculated by hand. Drawn on paper. While 80 athletes stand around waiting.

None of this is unique to one organizer or one club. It's just how archery tournaments have always worked — and it's what Archeris is built to change.

2. What Archeris Actually Does

Archeris replaces that pile of spreadsheets, WhatsApp groups, and paper scorecards with one connected system. The platform is built around two core problems that every tournament faces: how to handle registration and payments before competition day, and how to manage scoring and results during it.

Ticketing: Everything Before Competition Day

Before any athlete steps on the field, there's a lot of administrative work that usually ends up scattered across email, spreadsheets, and messaging apps. Archeris consolidates all of it into one place.

Organizers set up their tournament once — bow divisions, age categories, quota limits per target butt, entry fees — and registration opens as a public self-service portal. Athletes sign up, pay through QRIS, Virtual Account, or PayPal, and receive a digital QR pass automatically. No manual payment verification, no printed lists to manage, no WhatsApp chasing. The organizer dashboard shows incoming registrations and payments in real time.

On competition day, venue staff scan each athlete's QR code at the gate for check-in. That's it. The roster is already in the system, target positions are already assigned, and everyone knows where they need to be.

Scoring: From First Arrow to Final Bracket

This is where traditional tournaments lose the most time. Paper scorecards have to be collected, walked back to the secretariat, and manually re-entered into a spreadsheet — all while athletes wait for results they can't see.

With Archeris, scorekeepers at the target line open their phone browser, enter a 5-character access code, and start logging arrow values end by end. No app to install, no account to create. The interface is designed for outdoor conditions — large touch buttons, high contrast display — and scores sync to the leaderboard the moment they're submitted.

When the final qualification end is locked, the system calculates the complete ranking order automatically, including tie-breakers based on 10s count then Xs count, and immediately generates the elimination bracket. Recurve and Barebow follow the Set Play System, Compound uses Cumulative scoring, and bye placements are handled correctly by default. The bracket is ready before the organizer even stands up from their chair.

Worth noting: you don't have to use both modules. If you only need ticketing and online registration for your event, that works perfectly on its own. Scoring is fully opt-in.

3. How It All Fits Together

The reason Archeris feels different from just using separate tools is that data flows automatically from one stage to the next. You set up registration, athletes sign up and pay, target positions get assigned, scorekeepers log results, and the bracket builds itself — without you re-entering anything at any point.

A tournament that would typically require a team of volunteers manually passing data between systems now runs with one organizer watching a dashboard. The scorebook is verified and ready to download the moment competition ends. Certificates go out the same day.

That's the actual shift — not just faster execution of the same tasks, but removing entire categories of work that used to be unavoidable.

4. Who Uses Archeris

Because tournaments involve more than just the organizer, Archeris gives each type of user their own space rather than forcing everyone through the same interface.

Tournament organizers work from a full web dashboard — event configuration, participant management, payment verification, target allocation, scoring controls, and financial reports are all in one place. The mobile app also lets organizers scan QR codes for on-site check-in.

Archers and athletes fill in their profile once and never have to re-enter their information. Every tournament they register for pulls from the same saved profile. They can track their target schedule, follow their scores live during qualification, and download their certificate when the event is over.

Club coaches and team managers can register an entire delegation across multiple divisions in a single checkout. During the competition, they can monitor each athlete's live score from anywhere — no need to crowd around a notice board at the secretariat.

Field scorekeepers don't need an account at all. A browser and a 5-character code is everything they need. This matters more than it sounds — getting volunteers set up quickly and without friction on competition morning makes a real difference.

5. Manual vs Archeris: Side by Side

To put it concretely, here's what each stage of a tournament looks like with and without Archeris:

Tournament Stage The Old Way With Archeris
Registration & Payment Google Form entries, WhatsApp payment proofs, manual bank mutation checks Self-service portal, payments verified automatically in real time
Target Allocation Manual Excel with duplicate number risks and formula errors 1-click automated assignment with printable target sheets
Score Recording Paper scorecards collected per round, re-typed into computers at the secretariat Direct mobile entry at the target line, synced instantly
Elimination Brackets Manual tie-breaker calculations, hours spent drawing bracket trees by hand Auto-generated bracket with correct seedings, byes, and shoot-offs
Results & Certificates Paper printouts on a notice board, physical certificates mailed out weeks later Live online leaderboard, verifiable e-certificates available immediately

The time saved on scoring math and payment tracking alone is usually measured in hours per event day — and that's before accounting for the errors that don't happen anymore.

6. Getting Started

There's no technical setup required. Accounts are free and the full dashboard is available to explore before you commit to anything.

If you're an archer, create a free account, fill in your profile once, and you're ready to register for any tournament on the platform. Your details carry over automatically every time.

If you're running a tournament, create an organizer account, complete your organization profile, and walk through the tournament creation wizard to publish your first event. Before competition day, you can run the scoring and bracket features in practice mode with your field team so everyone knows the flow.

The rest of this documentation covers each part of the platform in detail — ticketing setup, qualification scoring, elimination bracket rules, and more. Each guide is focused on one topic so it's easy to find what you need.

id.title: Mengenal Platform Archeris
id.excerpt: Archeris adalah platform ticketing dan scoring khusus untuk turnamen panahan — dari pendaftaran online, pembayaran otomatis, pencatatan skor live di bantalan, sampai bagan eliminasi instan, semua di satu tempat.

toc.text: 1. Masalah Nyata di Balik Penyelenggaraan Turnamen Panahan

id.content:
Tanya siapapun yang pernah jadi panitia turnamen panahan, bagian paling melelahkan dari kerjaan mereka apa — hampir pasti bukan soal cari venue atau sponsor. Jawabannya biasanya sama: ngecek struk transfer satu per satu di WhatsApp, hitung skor manual, dan gambar bagan eliminasi di atas kertas sambil atlet pada nunggu.

Di situlah Archeris masuk. Platform web dan mobile ini dibangun khusus untuk turnamen panahan, mencakup semua kebutuhan mulai dari pendaftaran peserta sampai distribusi sertifikat akhir event.

1. Masalah Nyata di Balik Penyelenggaraan Turnamen Panahan

Kalau pernah bantu bikin turnamen panahan dengan cara lama, pasti hafal dramanya. Pendaftaran masuk lewat Google Form. Struk transfer banjiri WhatsApp grup panitia. Seseorang harus cek mutasi bank satu per satu. Spreadsheet alokasi bantalan punya rumus yang salah dan baru ketahuan pas hari H. Lalu di lapangan, kertas skor basah kena hujan, sukarelawan salah baca tulisan tangan, dan tiba-tiba ada dua pemanah dengan skor yang tidak cocok sama yang mereka tembak.

Belum lagi bagan eliminasi yang harus dihitung dan digambar tangan. Sementara 80 atlet berdiri menunggu hasilnya.

Ini bukan masalah satu-dua panitia yang kurang rapi. Ini memang sudah jadi cara kerja turnamen panahan selama bertahun-tahun — dan itulah yang Archeris rancang untuk diubah.

2. Apa yang Sebenarnya Dilakukan Archeris

Archeris menggantikan tumpukan spreadsheet, grup WhatsApp, dan kertas skor itu dengan satu sistem yang saling terhubung. Platform ini dibangun di atas dua masalah utama yang selalu dihadapi setiap turnamen: bagaimana mengelola pendaftaran dan pembayaran sebelum hari H, dan bagaimana mengelola scoring serta hasil selama kompetisi berlangsung.

Ticketing: Semua yang Terjadi Sebelum Hari Lomba

Sebelum satu pun atlet menginjakkan kaki di lapangan, ada banyak pekerjaan administrasi yang biasanya berserakan di email, spreadsheet, dan aplikasi chat. Archeris mengumpulkan semuanya ke satu tempat.

Panitia setting event sekali saja — divisi busur, kelompok usia, batas kuota per bantalan, biaya pendaftaran — lalu pendaftaran langsung terbuka sebagai portal mandiri. Atlet daftar, bayar lewat QRIS, Virtual Account, atau PayPal, dan langsung dapat tiket digital QR secara otomatis. Tidak ada verifikasi pembayaran manual, tidak ada daftar cetak yang harus dijaga, tidak ada WhatsApp yang perlu dikejar. Dashboard organizer menampilkan semua pendaftar dan pembayaran masuk secara real-time.

Di hari lomba, petugas di pintu masuk tinggal scan QR code masing-masing atlet untuk check-in. Selesai. Daftar peserta sudah ada di sistem, posisi bantalan sudah terbagi, dan semua tahu harus ke mana.

Scoring: Dari Anak Panah Pertama sampai Bagan Final

Di sinilah turnamen tradisional paling banyak kehilangan waktu. Kertas skor harus dikumpulkan, dibawa kembali ke sekretariat, dan diinput ulang satu per satu ke spreadsheet — sementara atlet menunggu hasil yang belum bisa mereka lihat.

Dengan Archeris, petugas skor di samping bantalan buka browser ponsel, ketik kode akses 5 karakter, langsung bisa input nilai panah per rambahan. Tidak perlu instal aplikasi, tidak perlu buat akun. Tampilan dirancang untuk kondisi lapangan outdoor — tombol besar, kontras tinggi — dan skor langsung tersinkron ke papan klasemen begitu disubmit.

Saat rambahan kualifikasi terakhir dikunci, sistem langsung menghitung ranking lengkap secara otomatis, termasuk tie-break berdasarkan jumlah 10 lalu jumlah X, dan seketika itu juga membentuk bagan aduan eliminasi. Recurve dan Barebow menggunakan Sistem Set, Compound pakai Skor Kumulatif, dan penempatan posisi bye sudah benar secara default. Bagan terbentuk sebelum panitia sempat bangkit dari kursinya.

Satu hal yang perlu dicatat: kamu tidak harus pakai kedua modul sekaligus. Kalau event hanya butuh sistem pendaftaran dan tiket online, ticketing saja sudah cukup. Scoring bersifat opsional sepenuhnya.

3. Bagaimana Semua Ini Saling Terhubung

Yang membuat Archeris berbeda dari sekadar pakai alat-alat terpisah adalah data mengalir otomatis dari satu tahapan ke tahapan berikutnya. Pendaftaran dibuka, atlet daftar dan bayar, posisi bantalan dibagi, petugas input skor, bagan terbentuk sendiri — tanpa ada satu data pun yang perlu diinput ulang.

Turnamen yang biasanya butuh tim relawan untuk memindahkan data antar sistem kini bisa berjalan dengan satu organizer yang memantau dashboard. Scorebook sudah terverifikasi dan siap diunduh begitu kompetisi selesai. Sertifikat bisa dikirim di hari yang sama.

Itulah perubahan nyatanya — bukan sekadar mengerjakan hal yang sama dengan lebih cepat, tapi menghilangkan seluruh kategori pekerjaan yang selama ini tidak bisa dihindari.

4. Siapa Saja yang Pakai Archeris

Karena turnamen melibatkan lebih dari sekadar panitia, Archeris memberi masing-masing tipe pengguna ruang kerjanya sendiri — bukan memaksa semua orang lewat antarmuka yang sama.

Panitia turnamen bekerja dari dashboard web lengkap — konfigurasi event, manajemen peserta, verifikasi pembayaran, alokasi bantalan, kontrol scoring, dan laporan keuangan semuanya di satu tempat. Aplikasi mobile juga tersedia untuk scan QR check-in di venue.

Pemanah dan atlet mengisi profil sekali, tidak perlu isi ulang lagi. Setiap turnamen yang mereka ikuti menarik data dari profil yang sama. Mereka bisa pantau jadwal bantalan, ikuti skor mereka sendiri secara live selama kualifikasi, dan unduh sertifikat begitu event selesai.

Pelatih dan pengurus klub bisa daftarkan seluruh kontingen lintas divisi dalam satu kali proses. Selama kompetisi berlangsung, mereka bisa pantau skor tiap atlet binaan dari mana saja — tidak perlu berkerumun di papan pengumuman sekretariat.

Petugas skor lapangan sama sekali tidak butuh akun. Browser dan kode 5 karakter, itu saja yang dibutuhkan. Hal ini lebih penting dari yang kelihatan — menyiapkan relawan dengan cepat tanpa ribet di pagi hari lomba benar-benar membuat perbedaan.

5. Manual vs Archeris: Perbandingan Langsung

Supaya lebih konkret, ini perbandingan tiap tahapan turnamen dengan dan tanpa Archeris:

Tahapan Turnamen Cara Lama Dengan Archeris
Pendaftaran & Pembayaran Google Form, struk transfer banjiri WhatsApp, cek mutasi bank manual satu per satu Portal mandiri, pembayaran terverifikasi otomatis secara real-time
Alokasi Bantalan Excel manual yang rawan bentrok nomor dan rumus yang salah Penempatan otomatis 1-klik lengkap dengan lembar cetak bantalan
Pencatatan Skor Kertas skor dikumpulkan tiap sesi, lalu diketik ulang di sekretariat Input langsung di samping bantalan lewat ponsel, tersinkron instan
Bagan Eliminasi Hitung tie-break manual, gambar bagan tanding di kertas berjam-jam Bagan terbentuk otomatis dengan seeding, bye, dan shoot-off yang benar
Hasil & Sertifikat Papan pengumuman kertas, sertifikat fisik yang butuh berminggu-minggu Papan klasemen live online, e-sertifikat terverifikasi langsung tersedia

Waktu yang dihemat dari hitung skor dan tracking pembayaran saja biasanya diukur dalam jam per hari lomba — belum termasuk kesalahan-kesalahan yang tidak lagi terjadi.

6. Cara Mulai

Tidak perlu setup teknis apapun. Akun gratis dan seluruh fitur dashboard bisa dijelajahi sebelum kamu commit ke apapun.

Kalau kamu seorang pemanah, buat akun gratis, isi profil sekali, dan kamu sudah siap daftar ke turnamen manapun di platform ini. Data kamu terbawa otomatis setiap kali.

Kalau kamu panitia turnamen, buat akun organizer, lengkapi profil organisasi, lalu ikuti wizard pembuatan turnamen untuk publish event pertama. Sebelum hari H, fitur scoring dan bagan bisa dicoba dalam mode latihan bersama tim lapangan supaya semua orang tahu alurnya.

Dokumentasi selanjutnya membahas masing-masing bagian platform secara lebih detail — setup ticketing, sistem skoring kualifikasi, aturan bagan eliminasi, dan lainnya. Masing-masing fokus ke satu topik supaya mudah dicari.
